rootCause: The active Nginx virtual host forwarded four web locations to 127.0.0.1:3102, where no process was listening. The healthy web container was bound to 127.0.0.1:3106. Its build also proxied same-origin API requests to an unavailable container-local port.
changes: Changed the four web upstreams from 127.0.0.1:3102 to 127.0.0.1:3106.
Kept /api/revalidate on the Next.js web upstream.
Changed other /api/* traffic to the healthy local API upstream at 127.0.0.1:4101 with the /api prefix removed.
